decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line close to the core offer and aligned with the firm's stated strategic direction, early results are unlikely to trigger problemistic search, and the firm's slack lets it carry the line while results mature.

The organic poultry snack fits the organic expansion and gets its own web page, but as a niche single item in a crowded snacking segment it is more exposed to falling short of aspirations, though one year is too early to drop it.

The premium sharing salami line uses existing curing and maturation capabilities at low incremental cost and has a dedicated page, so absent clear evidence of underperformance management would keep it.
